title: Summary
text: This session had two parallel tracks. The first completed recursive auto-discovery: the compiler can now scan any external directory tree for AgentWiki-compatible nodes (report dirs with manifest+HTML, standalone HTML files, and Markdown docs) without requiring files to be manually copied into samples/. A --scan CLI flag wires this into all three commands. The agentwiki_survey_final_plan.html in the workspace reports/ directory is now ingested as report:agent-run-001 with 11 sections via the new html_file manifest field and h2-fallback section extraction. The second track applied 5 patches from Claude web (Phase 3 re-implementation, Phase 4 Kuzu knowledge graph, test suite, security hardening, sparse TF-IDF fix) onto a clean branch from main. All patches applied without conflicts. Both existing PRs (#1 Phase 3 search, #2 GitHub Actions) were merged into main, and a new PR #3 was opened for the patch branch.

title: Changes
text: compiler/compiler.py: Added discover_nodes(), _in_skip_dir(), skip constants; updated run() to accept scan_roots. compiler/parser/html_report.py: Added html_file manifest field support, h2 section fallback in parse_report_dir, new parse_standalone_html(). compiler/cli.py: Added --scan/-s option on compile, dev, build commands. tests/test_discover_nodes.py: New, 17 pytest tests. tests/__init__.py: New empty package marker. reports/agent-run-001/manifest.json: New manifest wiring up agentwiki_survey_final_plan.html via html_file field. CLAUDE.md: Added testing mandate and end-of-session memory checklist. compiler/search.py: Phase 3 TF-IDF sparse fix. compiler/graph.py: New Phase 4 Kuzu graph builder. site/src/lib/sanitize.ts: New HTML sanitization util. site/src/pages/graph.astro: New graph visualization page. tests/test_graph.py, tests/test_search.py: New pytest coverage files.

title: Affected Code
text: discover_nodes(root, seen_ids): new function; rglob for manifest.json, *.md, *.html; skip logic; deduplication via seen_ids + seen_html_paths. _in_skip_dir(path): helper checking path parts against _SKIP_DIRS frozenset. parse_report_dir(): extended with html_file field support and h2-based section fallback. parse_standalone_html(): new two-mode parser for structured and unstructured HTML. run(): extended to accept scan_roots list. CLI commands compile, dev, build_cmd: each gains --scan/-s option. compiler/graph.py: new module for Phase 4 Kuzu graph builder. site/src/lib/sanitize.ts: new HTML sanitization module. site/src/pages/graph.astro: new graph visualization page.

title: Evidence
text: Auto-discovery tests: 17/17 passed. Patch branch tests: 12/12 passed. Compile output: 9 nodes, report:agent-run-001 shows 11 sections. All 5 patches applied with git am --3way, 0 conflicts. PR #1 (feat/phase-3-search) merged into main. PR #2 (GitHub Actions) merged into main. PR #3 opened for patch branch at https://github.com/QuitQui/agentwiki/pull/3.
